blurb: Sunnyside Bowladrome Inc. offers 32 candlepin bowling lanes with new pinsetters and computer scoring. They host bowling leagues, family outings, and provide party planning services including birthday parties and corporate events. Amenities include a game room, Wi-Fi, lockers, shoe rental, and a professional bowling retail shop.
extraNote: Prices are subject to change without notice · Room clean-up fee of $75 is a required deposit · Cash only; ATM available at the center
